title: aurum-diagnostics-integrations-rambling
content:
Context:
- Customer: Aurum Diagnostics (diagnostic imaging + triage assistant for clinicians).
- Use case: real-time summary + structured extraction from radiology transcripts and structured vitals. Low latency for interactive use in EMR sidebar (target <200ms p50 for short prompts, <500ms p95 for conversational flows).
- Compliance: HIPAA, customer requires KMS/HSM for keys and prefers private VPC deployment or air-gapped on-prem node for PHI.

Call notes (raw):
- They run in AWS GovCloud for some customers but have secure on-prem clusters for high-regulated hospitals.
- Primary txn: clinician pastes transcript (~200-400 tokens) + 2–3 follow-ups. Expect bursty pattern during rounds (30–40 parallel sessions).
- Concern: KV cache warmup when clinician hops between patients. They want near-instant recall of short-history context.
- Dataset: mix of short notes and longer reports; average sequence length ~700 tokens, 99th perc ~4k.
- They asked about model pinning and automated fallback to quantized variants when Dedicated capacity saturated.
- Question: can Redwood route requests so that PHI stays in customer VPC and only metrics flow to Redwood console? Answered: yes via Private control plane + optional telemetry redaction, but need to validate audit log model.

Technical gotchas / risks observed during discussion:
- On-prem GPU memory: they run primarily A100-40GB and a handful of 80GB nodes. Large-context models (8k+) will require sharding or slower variants. Need to quantify exact memory headroom for KV cache + dynamic batching.
- Cold-starts for cold patient contexts: continuous prefix caching helps but may introduce staleness if patient context updates mid-session. Must document cache TTL semantics.
- Quantization tradeoffs: their NLU accuracy threshold is tight for extraction tasks (precision > 0.94). We should recommend int8/4-bit experiments but pair with prompt-based QA evals to ensure no regression.
- Network segmentation: some hospitals enforce strict egress rules; Private deployment packaging must support single-direction telemetry push or a telemetry proxy.
- Observability: they want traceable per-request patient_id hashed token to match EMR sessions — ensure hashing scheme and salt agreed for privacy.

Requirements captured (customer asks / acceptance criteria):
1) Deploy Private control plane with customer-managed KMS (HSM preferred) and redacted telemetry by default.
2) SLA: p50 <200ms for 0–512 token prompts, p95 <500ms for typical flow under steady-state (30 concurrent).
3) Autoscale policy: fast ramp for bursts during rounds (scale to 40 sessions within 3 minutes).
4) Model quality: maintain extraction precision >=0.94 on their labeled test set (we need their eval set).
5) Fallback policy: automatic swap to CPU-hosted smaller model only for read-only summarization, never for extraction to avoid regressions.
6) Audit logs: full request/response metadata retained for 90 days in encrypted S3 (customer-managed).

Immediate follow-ups / next steps (owner tags):
- Maya: share baseline perf matrix spreadsheet template and ask for their anonymized sample traces (due 2024-11-13).
- Ethan: schedule infra feasibility call with their SRE to confirm node sizes and allowed ports (target 2024-11-15).
- Lena: draft quantization + eval plan (int8 vs int4) and list the set of unit tests we will run against their extraction labels (due 2024-11-18).
- Victor: assemble cost estimate for Dedicated + private control plane including licensing and optional HSM (first draft 2024-11-20).

Experiment ideas / quick wins (brainstorm):
- Prefix-preserving cache: pre-index common patient metadata blocks (demographics, recent meds) so clinician switches warm instantly. Need to discuss TTL and invalidation hooks from EMR.
- Hybrid routing: low-latency convs -> Hosted low-inference-cost variant in their VPC; sensitive extraction -> run on-device Private instance. Could be explicit route by endpoint.
- Micro-batching window tuning: for rounds bursts, a 5–10ms micro-batch window may net 12–18% throughput improvement with negligible latency hit for p95. Prototype with their trace sample.
- Eval harness: build an automated daily regression run using their labeled extraction set, run on every candidate quantized model + baseline and post results to a private dashboard.

Open questions to clarify with customer:
- Are there any legal vendor restrictions on shipping model weights (they flagged some partner contracts)?
- Which specific HSM / KMS vendors do they already use? (Thales, AWS CloudHSM, SoftHSM?)
- Do they require offline zero-telemetry mode where nothing leaves the air-gapped cluster? If yes, can we still offer console features via sidecar/manual export?
- Expected retention period for patient-level logs before customer-side purge?

Rough prompt pattern they shared (from demo):
- System: "You are a clinical assistant. Extract diagnosis codes and key findings; return JSON with fields: primary_dx, supporting_findings[], recommended_next_steps[]"
- User: free text transcript + vitals block (structured)
- Post-processing: regex validator against ICD-10 whitelist + confidence threshold 0.85

Potential blockers internally:
- Need SRE time to validate onprem packaging for their strict egress rules (tickets needed).
- Research/Applied-ML needs to own the quantization QA pipeline; may need compute budget.

Notes to self / informal:
- When prepping perf run, include two workloads: "rounds burst" (many short sessions) and "deep-read" (fewer long contexts).
- For TTL, propose default 30s for per-session cache and 6h for patient-level cache with explicit invalidation hook.
- Keep fallback policy conservative: only route to smaller model when extraction task confidence falls below 0.7 AND extraction is not PHI-sensitive.

Meeting artifacts to collect from Aurum: anonymized trace file (500–2k requests), labeled extraction set (500 examples), list of node types + network ACLs, HSM vendor info.

Action log (short):
- 2024-11-07: Maya emailed perf template.
- 2024-11-09: Aurum sent partial trace sample (redacted). Need full sample.
- 2024-11-11: Internal kickoff with solutions + research — quantization plan drafted.

End of scratch — keep this loose. Will refine into formal SOW once we confirm traces and HSM constraints.
summary: Working scratch for Aurum Diagnostics private deploy: call notes, constraints (HIPAA/HSM), perf targets, quantization risk, cache strategies, action items with owners and deadlines.
